status_when_written: question generation and parsing in progress; no retrieval or answer results exist
dataset_sha256_note: filled once, when the 400-question shortlist is frozen and before the first cell runs
questions_answered: Q1 chunkers, retrieval: does grain_growth retrieve better than recursive_char and fixed_token?
Q2 chunkers, answers: does grain_growth produce better qwen3:4b answers?
Q3 parsers: does current, oss_docling or oss_pymupdf4llm retrieve or answer better?
Q4 parse fidelity: how many answer spans does each parser lose?
Q5 generalisation: do results differ between arXiv papers and never-trained YOLO-folder PDFs? (descriptive)

tests.binary: exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs (McNemar)
tests.continuous: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, zero differences dropped
tests.effect_intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, resampling papers not questions
tests.multiplicity: Holm within each metric's family of tests

verdict_rules.priority_order: fixed sequence: a comparison is tested on metric 2 only if it passed metric 1, and so on. The verdict is the result on metric 1; the report states how far down the order it held.

chunkers.better_if: B and D: significant win after Holm on at least 2 of 3 parsers, no significant loss on any parser, and pooled effect across parsers at or above the metric's threshold
chunkers.worse_if: the same rule with the direction reversed

parsers.differ_if: significant after Holm under at least 2 of 3 chunkers, consistent direction, pooled effect at or above the metric's threshold

parse_fidelity.metric: answer spans missing from the parser's own output, near match
parse_fidelity.test: exact McNemar per parser pair, Holm over 3 pairs

supporting_metrics_never_used_for_verdic: cost: parse s/page, VRAM, index s, s/question, chunks, context chars
chunk shape on the round-2 corpus: mid-sentence starts/ends, overlap, sizes
breakdowns: arXiv vs never-trained; question writer 120B vs 20B

judge_validation.method: agreement of NLI fact recall and Gemma correctness with the numeric reference set: questions whose short answer contains a number and is not a citation; 'correct' when Qwen's answer contains that number after normalisation
judge_validation.use: reported as validity evidence; does not change the priority order

data_handling.question_set: frozen before the first cell; identical 400 questions in every cell
data_handling.generation_errors: excluded pairwise from that comparison, counts reported
data_handling.refusals: scored as incorrect (0) for answer metrics, and counted in refusal rate
data_handling.judging: all local; no external API calls; qwen3:4b never judges; judge sees no parser or chunker labels
